title: Sable and the Wreck
author: Xanthe Nystrom
blurb: Silas Dunmore, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. Then an expedition upriver stops answering the radio — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the concession permits expire.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
